Maya Patel: Quick heads-up — spun up coral-v2 6-bit quant on staging for a similarity sanity check. recall@10 on wiki-small dropped from 0.763 (fp16) -> 0.728. cosine mean shifted ~-0.015. anyone seen this with prefix cache + 6-bit?
Samir: hmm, that's larger than i'd expect. did you run with prefix cache and microbatching on?
Maya Patel: yes prefix cache = on, microbatch=32, batch_size=512. used per-tensor symmetric quant.
Lucas H: can you paste the eval command you ran?
Maya Patel: `./eval_runner --dataset wiki-small --model coral-v2 --quant=6bit --method=symmetric --bs=512 --k=10`
Anika R: try per-channel quantization and set clamp=false. per-tensor symmetric tends to crush small angular differences in some of these models.
Samir: also try disabling KV prefix cache — sometimes cache mismatch + low-bit quant amplifies small deltas.
Maya Patel: kicking off two runs now: (A) per-channel 6-bit, (B) same but kv-cache disabled. ETA ~30m. queued logs show: ```k=10 baseline=0.763 coral-6bit-sym=0.728```
ops-bot: eval-job 46721 queued for coral-v2 (6-bit) — we'll post artifacts to s3 when done
Lucas H: if per-channel gets us back above ~0.75 then we can tune scales; otherwise consider a small calibration set (1k examples) for layerwise scale updates.
Maya Patel: ack. also adding a quick cluster sanity probe (kmeans n=50) + silhouette score to the pipeline so we can see geometry drift.
Anika R: good call. if silhouette drops a lot it means topology distortion, not just rank shift. tag me when results land @anika
Samir: i'll also eyeball the compiled kernels for coral-v2's 6-bit path — kernel selection sometimes changes heuristics and affects numerical error.
Maya Patel: will share run diffs (similarity histograms, cluster medoids, and recall delta) once jobs finish. thanks all :thumbsup:
